question: Which of the following is equal to ∑ₖ₌₁⁶ (k - 1)²?
What does ∑ₙ₌₁⁵ (2n - 1) represent?
options: It is the sum of the first five natural numbers.
It is the sum of the first five even natural numbers.
It is the sum of the first five odd natural numbers.
It is the sum of the first five non negative integers.
explanation:
∑ₙ₌₁⁵(2n−1) =

 (2×1−1)+(2×2−1)+(2×3−1)+(2×4−1)+(2×5−1) =

 1+3+5+7+9. 

Therefore, it represents the sum of the first five odd natural numbers.
